paragraphs: Listed below are works not included in *Great Books of the Western World*, but relevant to the idea and topics with which this chapter deals. These works are divided into two groups:
I. Works by authors represented in this collection.
II. Works by authors not represented in this collection.
For the date, place, and other facts concerning the publication of the works cited, consult the Bibliography of Additional Readings, which follows the last chapter of *The Great Ideas*.
DANTE. *On World-Government or De Monarchia*, BK I, CH II; BK II, CH 6
HUME. *A Treatise of Human Nature*, BK III, PART II, SECT I–VI
A. SMITH. *The Theory of Moral Sentiments*, PART II
——. *Lectures on Justice, Police, Revenue and Arms*
HEGEL. *The Philosophy of Mind*, SECT II, SUB-SECT C, (BB, b, c)
SAADIA GAON. *The Book of Beliefs and Opinions*, TREATISE IV–V, IX

GROTIUS. *The Rights of War and Peace*
